slides.body: The 6th, 8th and 12th houses are called dusthanas (difficult houses). They are linked with struggle, upheaval and loss.
Vipreet Raja Yoga (reversal yoga) arises when the lord of one dusthana sits in another. Tradition says difficulty can convert into resilience.

points: Find the lords of your 6th, 8th and 12th
See if one sits in another dusthana
Check that lord's strength and dasha timing
Ask a trained astrologer to confirm

slides.body: No yoga guarantees success. Every yoga depends on strength, timing and effort. This is a lens, not a promise.

slides.h2: Find yoga patterns in your chart
